sourceAssessments.assessment: Native click detail0 goes through callback once; fast desktop pointer action remains mousedown, subsequent pointer click ignored. Existing disabled/allowDisabledClick contract retained; latest custom disabled test is forced pointer count0, not an additional keyboard-disabled fixture.

Contained checkbox/radio/select joins targeted interactive Enter delegation; textarea/contenteditable/MenuItem/native buttons and anchors retain target handling. Single-line text input baseline onEnter remains; unowned outside Enter is prevented/consumed.

Only a distinct target-owned .Modal currently open (or native dialog[open]) and not closing/not-shown/not-open makes unrelated Modal Enter handler returnfalse; same narrow owner guard is applied to Escape. Global capture ordering is unchanged.

Neutral container fallback checks actual document.activeElement identity, index-1, non-destructive and enabled. Native button paths therefore activate only native click; target check resolves Tab/default focus duplicate.

Actual trigger lookup does not depend on isOpen, owner derives from trigger.closest(.Modal .modal-container), closed dynamic portal with no trigger does not render. Owner selector/key persists through close; own bubble ref replaces ambiguous global query for owned menus.

Owned modal Escape prevents native dialog cancel, restores exact trigger focus and closes menu; subsequent Escape closes exact owner. Modal-container fixed viewport geometry remains compatible with portal coordinates.
Propagation sentinel exits registered stack without stopping target event. false delegates to next handler; native Enter/Space targets remain handled by their own components.
Actual focusable span trigger handles Enter/Space explicitly with preventDefault; role button does not create a second native click.
Unchanged source; no global navigation alteration needed for neutral Confirm target fix.
